conviction_note: The core of H1 is already out: on 1 Oct 2026 Landsec said the H1 valuation would be broadly stable and lettings ran comfortably ahead of ERV, and it reiterated LFL NRI +3-5% and flat FY27 EPS. The only real unknown is whether the guide is nudged up, as it was at H1 last year. Last year's raise was followed by a -5.26% day, and the stock has run +16% from its 8 Oct low to the 698p sealed spot, close to the c.700p consensus target. So abs_move is set at 4.0, above the 1.53 proxy because the H1 days moved 6.5/4.3/-5.3. p_up sits at 52, which leaves the signed number near zero. The findings sum to +0.6, mostly an unsourced possible guide nudge.

findings.finding: The H1 operating story was pre-released on 1 Oct: lettings comfortably ahead of ERV, H1 valuation broadly stable, LFL NRI +3-5% reiterated, FY27 EPS flat vs 51.4p.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 days moved +6.51% (Nov 2023), +4.31% (Nov 2024) and -5.26% (Nov 2025). Those moves came on guidance and valuation reads, not on pre-released lines.
findings.original_quote: our overall portfolio valuation is expected to be broadly stable over the first half of the year
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It was an RNS inside a heavily covered £500m placing document six weeks ago, and the stock has risen from 607.5p to 698p since. Kept at 0 because the market has already been told.
findings.independence: Bluewater RNS of 13 Oct (retail sales +7.4% vs national -1.7%) supports the same operating read: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/land-securities-group--land/landsec-acquires-a-further-10-stake-in-bluewater-/9819139

findings.finding: Leasing ahead of ERV, Bluewater sales running about 9pp ahead of the national average, and accretive retail acquisitions the company says 'bring forward some of this growth into FY28' all leave room for a guidance nudge (upper half of LFL 3-5%, or a firmer FY28 EPS number). Last year's H1 did raise LFL guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 H1: LFL guidance raised to 4-5%, stock -5.26% on the day (Quilter: 'raises guidance but leaves a complicated picture'). Nov 2024 H1: +4.31%. So a raise has been both bought and sold.
findings.original_quote: The Acquisitions and Equity Issue further improve visibility on this potential and bring forward some of this growth into FY28.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock is +16% off its 8 Oct low and sits near the c.700p consensus target, which is what pricing in an upgrade would look like. What is not knowable is whether the company formalises it. This is an inference with no sourced bar, so it is held small.
findings.independence: Bluewater trading: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/land-securities-group--land/landsec-acquires-a-further-10-stake-in-bluewater-/9819139; precedent of the H1 raise: https://media.quilter.com/search/2025/landsec-raises-guidance-but-leaves-a-complicated-picture/

findings.finding: Rates have moved against UK property since the period began. The 10y gilt is at 5.26% on 12 Nov 2026, +0.82pt year on year, with further BoE hikes priced. That is a risk to H2 valuation language and the yield outlook, although the company says ERV growth offset it over H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable in the history. REIT prints in a rising-rate tape are sold on the valuation outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro, so mostly priced. The gilt yield is down 0.18pt over the month, which is part of why the sector rallied (BLND +13% since 8 Oct alongside LAND). The transmission to company level is a hypothesis, and the company has already said H1 valuations held, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The company's own 1 Oct statement acknowledges the rise in rates since March: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/land-securities-group--land/landsec-proposed-equity-issue-/9800232

findings.finding: The £500m placing at 600p funded retail assets at 7.4-7.9% yields (Metrocentre completed 29 Oct; Bluewater stake to 74%). It lowers pro forma LTV to 37.7% and net debt/EBITDA to 7.9x, and is EPS-accretive from FY28. This is a post-balance-sheet item that the release will restate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1 Oct 2026, the placing day: 624.5p to 607.5p (-2.7%), fully recovered within two weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock trades 16% above the placing price. What remains is integration detail and the pro forma metrics in the release.

findings.finding: Disclosed shorts of 3.80% (FCA, 9 Nov) are covering, down 0.23pp, into the print. That is modest fuel if the guide is nudged up.
findings.why_not_priced: It agrees with the sealed lean (+2.38), so it is mostly the baseline, not an edge. Kept small.
